svg.text: Seven composable skills for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and GitHub Copilot. Each step in the delivery loop
offers the next — in the same session or a fresh one via drakom-handoff — and waits for your yes.
pass audit later for a read-only check
copyable prompt for a fresh session
offered after Plan, Dev, Review or PR
builds one PR · failing test first
runs checks, re-reads diff, updates plan
offers a fresh-session prompt for the reviewer
reviews local branch or GitHub PR
up to 3 rounds: author fixes Important items
runs checks, re-reviews in fresh context
reused if review already ran on HEAD
pushes, opens PR & links it in the plan
optional on open PR: posts one GitHub review
proposes Done, move to specs/, or delete
Every skill also runs on its own: start with drakom-dev from a request without a plan, or run drakom-review on any branch or PR.
Indigo arrows send a brief to a fresh context so blind risk checks and reviewers never see the author's conversation; grey arrows return results or hand off.
Project rules in .drakom-ai/rules/ and AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md guide the workflow.
